sources.entry: Pika - Is an easy to use, open-source, native colour picker for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Pika is an open-source, native macOS colour picker that samples colours from anywhere on screen and checks text contrast using WCAG 2 or APCA.
summary.what_it_does: Pika lets you pick colours from anywhere on screen using either the macOS sampler or its Pro picker with a live loupe. It shows colour values in Hex, RGB, HSB, HSL, LAB, OpenGL and OKLCH, in sRGB or Display P3. It checks contrast between a foreground and background using WCAG 2 or APCA. Users can click, type, scrub or step values, and it keeps colour names, history, and undo/redo. Global shortcuts and a pika:// URL scheme let other tools or scripts trigger picking, copying, formatting and window actions.
use_cases: pick colours from a design file or website
convert colours between hex, RGB, HSL and OKLCH
copy colour values for design or code
automate colour picking via URL scheme
how_to_run: Or download the latest version from superhighfives.com/pika
Open Pika.xcodeproj in Xcode and run (a team and signing profile must be set for Sparkle)
notable: Pro picker with live loupe, alongside the basic macOS sampler
Contrast checking with both WCAG 2 and APCA
pika:// URL scheme for automation of picking, copying, and formatting
Supports sRGB and Display P3 colour spaces
Global shortcut for pick and show/hide from any app
caveats: Pro picker needs Screen Recording permission
Building from source needs a team and signing profile set for Sparkle or the app crashes
